Full-state threat-aware eight-way terrain-cost routing and UI row choices; established runtime RNG seed 20261020, PYTHONHASHSEED=20261020. Ordinary starter equipment/food/water only. Normal AI, FOV, survival, costs and resource depletion. No staging, teleportation, threat clearing, invincibility, injected supplies, synthetic injury/recovery or resets. A single F9 restores the named in-progress snapshot after one actual unsaved wait.

possessions.name: Tallow Torch
possessions.description: A rush dipped in rendered fat. It smells of the animal it came from. It will burn for a while.

possessions.name: Crow Jerky
possessions.description: Strips of dried crow meat. It tastes exactly as you would expect. It sustains you regardless.

possessions.name: Water Flask
possessions.description: A clay flask of water. It is flat and has the faint taste of the vessel. It is better than nothing, which is the alternative.

possessions.name: a crude blade
possessions.description: Iron, poorly kept. It will serve.

possessions.name: a leather jack
possessions.description: Cured hide, stitched with sinew. Old work. It will hold.

possessions.name: moist pebble
possessions.description: Perpetually damp. Woven round with twine by hands that knew what they were doing. Certain stones feel different when this is on thy person.

native_crate.name: bundle of wood
native_crate.description: A loose bundle of dry branches. Snapped from dead fall.

pages.text:
A stalker's musk gland dries into a pellet beside a stationary fire. Lay it within the fire's warmth and give it time.

A carried torch can light a prepared fire. The torch alone is no place to dry a gland.

Break the prepared pellet and its musk briefly disrupts nearby creatures. Use those moments to move away. The smell passes; the danger may remain.
